question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

EMBELLISH
solution:
The correct answer is** "decorate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Embellish"** means **to make something more attractive or interesting by adding decorative details or features.**

 
 
• **Example:**​ The author tends to **embellish **his stories with exaggerated details.
 
 
 
• The word** "decorate" **means **to adorn, beautify or enhance the appearance of something by adding decorative details or ornaments.**
 
 
• For example: She **decorated **her house with beautiful paintings and sculptures.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "decrease," **means to make something smaller or less in size, quantity, or intensity.
 
• **Option 3, "reduce," **is similar to "decrease" and means to make something smaller or less in size, quantity, or value.
 
• **Option 4, "simplify,"** means to make something easier to understand, use, or do. It is not a synonym for "embellish."
